source='''from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                points[v].append((r, c))
    # Four paired diagonal marks form the ray-extension motif.
    if len(points) != 4 or any(len(ps) != 2 for ps in points.values()):
        return out
    centers = [(r, c) for ps in points.values() for r, c in ps]
    cr = sum(r for r, c in centers) / len(centers)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in centers) / len(centers)
    rays = []
    for color, ps in points.items():
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = ps
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        # Extend from the endpoint farther from the overall mark center.
        d1 = (r1-cr)**2 + (c1-cc)**2
        d2 = (r2-cr)**2 + (c2-cc)**2
        if d1 > d2:
            r, c, sr, sc = r1, c1, -dr, -dc
        else:
            r, c, sr, sc = r2, c2, dr, dc
        rays.append((color, r, c, sr, sc))
    for color, r, c, dr, dc in rays:
        rr, cc2 = r + dr, c + dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc2 < w:
            out[rr][cc2] = color
            rr += dr
            cc2 += dc
    return out
'''

source='''from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                pts[v].append((r, c))
    allpts = [p for ps in pts.values() for p in ps]
    if not allpts:
        return out
    cr = sum(r for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    cc = sum(c for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts)
    rays = set()
    for color, ps in pts.items():
        # Every adjacent equal-color diagonal pair marks a ray, directed
        # away from the center of the small multicolor motif.
        for i in range(len(ps)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(ps)):
                r1, c1 = ps[i]
                r2, c2 = ps[j]
                dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
                if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:
                    continue
                d1 = (r1-cr)**2 + (c1-cc)**2
                d2 = (r2-cr)**2 + (c2-cc)**2
                if abs(d1-d2) < 1e-9:
                    continue
                if d1 > d2:
                    r, c, sr, sc = r1, c1, -dr, -dc
                else:
                    r, c, sr, sc = r2, c2, dr, dc
                rays.add((color, r, c, sr, sc))
    for color, r, c, dr, dc in rays:
        rr, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= c2 < w:
            out[rr][c2] = color
            rr += dr
            c2 += dc
    return out
'''
